bio.text: Letitia James is the 67th Attorney General of New York, elected in 2018 and in office since 2019.
Before that she was New York City Public Advocate, elected in 2013, and spent ten years on the New York City Council representing the 35th District in Brooklyn.

She earlier headed the Brooklyn Regional Office of the state Attorney General's Office, began her career as a public defender at the Legal Aid Society, and graduated from Lehman College and Howard University School of Law.
